correctness.rationale: Five mod-p monic cubic factorization types count B0,B1,B3,B2,p. Simple roots lift uniquely mod p⁴. In the simple+double class, p² divides constant to enter quadratic H; its uniform mod-p discriminant gives 2p or 0 roots, with repeated branch next-digit 1/p giving p² roots. Triple branch requires p-adic divisibility of translated B,C, leaving uniform cubic G mod p and each G-root giving p² residues. These cases derive D_p,T_p and full PGF and 3p² extremizers. Independent exact rational PGF normalization/mean checks for p=3,5,7,11; separately enumerated all 531441 cubics mod 81, exact eight-bin histogram as stated and 81 maximizers. Enumeration p=3 is finite; proof handles all odd primes.
residual_risks: Computer checks are limited to the explicitly recorded finite cases; the unrestricted result rests on the reconstructed analytic proof, not extrapolation.
